description: Precedence (ADR 0026 §2 as clarified by ADR 0048: shape and limits, then signature base64url, then protected-header decoding (base64url, JSON, then per-parameter types and crit syntax), then the payload's base64url under the effective b64, then whole-header structure, then ADR 0026 §2 steps 5–9): an HS256 JWS verified with a 31-octet key (step 8) whose MAC is also wrong (first character changed, step 9) fails with the step 8 code
